question: A study is being conducted in a health center to determine the effect of exposure to tobacco smoke in children of smoking parents. For this purpose, a group of healthy children between 3 and 7 years old whose parents are smokers is selected and at the same time an equal number of children whose parents are non-smokers are selected in the same center. A year later, the appearance of respiratory diseases during that year will be investigated in both groups. Indicate the correct answer:

options.opa: The study design is a prospective cohort.
options.opb: The study design is cases and controls.
options.opc: The study design follows a qualitative methodology.
options.ope: The type of design used is efficient to study rare diseases.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Exposure to tobacco smoke in children of smoking parents -> Group of healthy children selected -> Investigate appearance of respiratory diseases after a year -> Prospective cohort study design -> 95%

CHAIN: Exposure to tobacco smoke in children of smoking parents -> Group of healthy children selected -> Investigate appearance of respiratory diseases after a year -> Efficient to study rare diseases -> 85%
enhanced_information: The study design is a prospective cohort as it involves selecting a group of healthy children exposed to tobacco smoke and investigating the appearance of respiratory diseases after a year. This design is efficient for studying rare diseases. The evidence path on causes of respiratory diseases supports the focus on investigating the impact of tobacco smoke exposure on respiratory health.
analysis: The study design described aligns with the characteristics of a prospective cohort study. This type of study involves selecting a group of individuals based on exposure status (smoking parents) and following them over time to observe the development of outcomes (respiratory diseases). The enhanced information confirms this alignment and highlights the efficiency of this design for studying rare diseases like the impact of tobacco smoke on respiratory health.
